verdict.rationale: WooCommerce documents webhooks that fire automatic event notifications to a URL of your choice when store events occur. Storefront's add_action() hooks let developers inject code into templates. Together these give event triggers, but the actual rule logic must live in an external endpoint or custom PHP; the evidence shows no native rule or workflow builder. Missing for 10: a native rule or condition builder, built-in actions beyond outbound HTTP notifications, documentation of available event and topic coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
